terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms before creating a DayGig account. They explain DayGig's role and your responsibilities when connecting with other users.

platform_role.title: DayGig's role
platform_role.body: DayGig is an online platform that helps users publish occasional work opportunities, requests for help, and service offers, and allows other users to contact or apply to them.

not_a_party.title: DayGig is not a party to user agreements
not_a_party.body: DayGig is not an employer, staffing agency, payment provider, mediator, or contracting party in agreements made between users. DayGig only provides tools that help users connect.

user_responsibility.title: Your decisions are your responsibility
user_responsibility.body: Users decide for themselves who they contact, which work they accept, which offers they make, where and when they meet, and which conditions they agree to.

offline_incidents.title: Offline interactions and incidents
offline_incidents.body: DayGig is not responsible for personal safety issues, unsafe behavior, accidents, injuries, damages, losses, harassment, or other incidents that happen outside the application or during offline interactions between users.

agreements_and_payments.title: Agreements and payments
agreements_and_payments.body: Users are responsible for clearly agreeing on the work details, time, location, compensation, payment method, and any other important conditions. DayGig is not responsible for payment disputes, unpaid work, cancelled arrangements, quality disputes, or agreements made between users.

verification.title: User information
verification.body: DayGig does not fully verify every user's identity, reliability, qualifications, permits, or the accuracy of information they provide. Users should use their own judgment before meeting or working with someone.

conduct.title: Expected conduct
conduct.body: Users must use DayGig legally, honestly, and with respect for the safety, rights, and dignity of others. Misleading, abusive, unlawful, dangerous, or harassing content and behavior are not allowed.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: DayGig may remove content, job posts, applications, or accounts that violate application rules, harm other users, or appear to violate applicable law.

acceptance.title: Acceptance during registration
acceptance.body: By registering, you confirm that you have read and accepted these Terms and Conditions and understand that DayGig operates as a connection platform.
